name: Security
definition: Financial instruments representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

RegisteredDistributionCountry.name: Registered Distribution Country
RegisteredDistributionCountry.definition: Country in which the processing characteristic applies.

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

RegistrationForm.name: Registration Form
RegistrationForm.definition: Specifies the form, ie, ownership, of the security.

DematerialisedIndicator.name: Dematerialised Indicator
DematerialisedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a security exists only as an electronic record, ie, there is no physical document representing the security.

EUSavingsDirective.name: EU Savings Directive
EUSavingsDirective.definition: Indicates whether the investment fund class is subject to the European Union Saving Directive.

TemporaryFinancialInstrumentIndicator.name: Temporary Financial Instrument Indicator
TemporaryFinancialInstrumentIndicator.definition: Specifies that the security is a temporary security.

AvailableDate.name: Available Date
AvailableDate.definition: Date on which securities become available for sale.

DeclarationDetails.name: Declaration Details
DeclarationDetails.definition: Provides declaration details narrative relative to the financial instrument, eg, beneficial ownership.

FungibleIndicator.name: Fungible Indicator
FungibleIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a security is interchangeable, ie, the security is allowed to be replaced by another security, without loss of value.

Appearance.name: Appearance
Appearance.definition: Specifies the deliverability of a security.

NearTermPositionLimit.name: Near Term Position Limit
NearTermPositionLimit.definition: Position limit in the near-term contract for a given exchange-traded product.

ContractSettlementMonth.name: Contract Settlement Month
ContractSettlementMonth.definition: Specifies when the contract (i.e. MBS/TBA) will settle.

MinimumTradingPricingIncrement.name: Minimum Trading Pricing Increment
MinimumTradingPricingIncrement.definition: Minimum price increase for a given exchange-traded Instrument

WarrantAttachedOnDelivery.name: Warrant Attached On Delivery
WarrantAttachedOnDelivery.definition: Indicates whether the warrants on a financial instrument (which has been traded cum warrants) will be attached on delivery.

StrippableIndicator.name: Strippable Indicator
StrippableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest is separable from the principal.

FirstDealingDate.name: First Dealing Date
FirstDealingDate.definition: Date on which new securities begin trading.

RecompositionIndicator.name: Recomposition Indicator
RecompositionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest and the principal can be recomposed. This is the reverse operation of stripping.

Series.name: Series
Series.definition: Identifier that links multiple security classes.

PercentageOfDebtClaim.name: Percentage Of Debt Claim
PercentageOfDebtClaim.definition: Percentage of the underlying assets of a fund that represents a debt and is in the scope of the EU Savings directive.

CoverRate.name: Cover Rate
CoverRate.definition: Amount of dividends the issuer intends to pay out the following year based on their normalised earnings.

MaturityRedemption.name: Maturity Redemption
MaturityRedemption.definition: Return of an investor's principal in a security at maturity.

PotentialEuroSystemEligibility.name: Potential Euro System Eligibility
PotentialEuroSystemEligibility.definition: Indicates that the security is intended to be held in a manner that could allow the Eurosystem eligibility.

RestrictedIndicator.name: Restricted Indicator
RestrictedIndicator.definition: Identifies if the securities is restricted or not (as per Rule 144 of the Securities and Exchange Commission,that sets the conditions under which restricted, unregistered and control securities can be sold).

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Specifies the quantity associated with a security.

Pricing.name: Pricing
Pricing.definition: Information on the price of the security.

SecuritiesAccount.name: Securities Account
SecuritiesAccount.definition: Account on which the security is held.

TradingMarket.name: Trading Market
TradingMarket.definition: Market(s) on which the security is traded.

PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Market(s) on which the security is listed.

Registration.name: Registration
Registration.definition: Information related to registration of securities.

Restriction.name: Restriction
Restriction.definition: Regulatory restriction(s) linked to the security.

CorporateEvent.name: Corporate Event
CorporateEvent.definition: Corporate event linked to the security

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Spread that uses the security as benchmark reference.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Balance of the account which holds a specific security.

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: Indicates the market sector the security is classified as pharmaceuticals, automobile, housing, etc.

SecuritiesTrade.name: Securities Trade
SecuritiesTrade.definition: Trade in which the security is involved.

RegistrationJurisdiction.name: Registration Jurisdiction
RegistrationJurisdiction.definition: Jurisdiction (country, county, state, province, city) in which the security is legally recorded for regulatory and/or tax purposes.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies roles played by a party that are linked to the handling of securities but not related to a specific process.

SecurityStatus.name: Security Status
SecurityStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the security within its lifecycle.

Modification.name: Modification
Modification.definition: Modification process which applies to a specific security.

SecuritiesTransfer.name: Securities Transfer
SecuritiesTransfer.definition: Transfer process in which that security is transferred..

CorporateActionStandingInstructions.name: Corporate Action Standing Instructions
CorporateActionStandingInstructions.definition: Standing instructions related to the security in the context of corporate action.

SecuritiesOrder.name: Securities Order
SecuritiesOrder.definition: Order for which a specific security is indicated.

RelatedVariableInterest.name: Related Variable Interest
RelatedVariableInterest.definition: Variable interest parameters specified for interest related to a financial instrument.

Conversion.name: Conversion
Conversion.definition: Information on the conversion exchange of an entitlement or of preferred equities or of convertible bonds, into another form of securities, usually common equities.

ComponentSecurity.name: Component Security
ComponentSecurity.definition: The security is part of the component security.

RelatedMarginCall.name: Related Margin Call
RelatedMarginCall.definition: Margin call for which the associated securities are specified.

CloseLink.name: Close Link
CloseLink.definition: Situation in which two entities are linked because one of these entities owns some of the capital of the other one, or has a control relationship with it.

MinimumQuantity.name: Minimum Quantity
MinimumQuantity.definition: Indicates the minimum tradable quantity of a security.
